DIDP.description: PSC Design Input for Design Position (DIDP). Fields select which element ends are checked for moment and shear design; both are element-end flags applied to a PSC design target element.

MOMENT_TYPE.description: Moment check position. 0=None, 1=I, 2=J, 3=I&J. Rejected if outside 0..3.

SHEAR_TYPE.description: Shear check position. 0=None, 1=I, 2=J, 3=I&J. Rejected if outside 0..3.
